definitions.meaning: a vote taken by raising arms in a meeting
workers are hands, and a concert is a show, so a concert put on by workers is a display of hands

explanation.surface: Someone backs a benefit gig put on by labourers.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising arms to count opinion is a common informal way of polling a meeting.

definitions.meaning: a pistol carried at the hip
a team is a side, and one of its limbs would be its arm

explanation.surface: Asking what weapon a squad player might carry.
explanation.definitionFit: A holstered pistol is the classic small firearm worn at the hip; the question mark flags the punning team-limb reading.

clue.text: He may have the lot or about three quarters

indicators.note: about means one word is placed around the other, so the letters of or go round the compass points

parts.note: W, N and E are three of the four compass points, or quarters

explanation.surface: Someone holds all the land, or perhaps just most of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Three quarters' looks like a fraction of the lot, but it means three of the four compass points, which 'about' puts inside the word or.
explanation.definitionFit: A lot is a plot of land or an auction item, and the person holding title possesses it.

clue.text: Musical production turned into theatrical work

parts.note: an opera is a sung stage production

indicators.note: turned means the letters of the word into are twisted round into a new order

explanation.surface: A stage musical gets adapted into a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned' rearranges the word into. 'Theatrical work' looks like a stage play but means work done in a hospital's operating theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgery is carried out in an operating theatre, so it is work done in a theatre.

parts.note: read as an instruction about a testament: the person named in a will to follow on and take over the estate

explanation.definitionFit: The successor named to inherit an estate under a testament is the next in line.

clue.text: They may be floored by the cheese

definitions.text: They may be floored by the cheese

parts.words: They may be floored by the cheese
parts.note: in skittles the thrown disc is called a cheese, and it knocks down the wooden targets

explanation.walkthrough: In the British pub game of skittles, the flat wooden disc that is thrown is called a cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Skittles set up in a group of nine are the targets that a thrown disc knocks over.

definitions.meaning: a follower of Zeno's school of philosophy

explanation.surface: A follower who shows no emotion.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek school founded by Zeno taught indifference to pain and pleasure, so its followers gave the word for unemotional endurance.

clue.text: Had a vision which put me in great fear

indicators.note: put me in means the word me is placed inside the word for great fear
put me in means the word me is placed inside the word for great fear

parts.note: dread is great fear

explanation.surface: Someone saw a terrifying vision that left them petrified.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing images while asleep is experiencing a vision in the night.

clue.text: Odd doctrine obtains goods without paying

indicators.note: odd means strange, so the letters of doctrine are rearranged into a strange order

explanation.surface: A strange creed lets people take goods for free.
explanation.definitionFit: Buying on deferred payment means taking goods now with no money handed over yet.

clue.text: I landed awkwardly on a plant

indicators.note: awkwardly means the letters of I landed are jumbled clumsily into a new order

explanation.surface: A parachutist comes down badly on top of some vegetation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awkwardly' rearranges I LANDED to DANDELI, and ON is added at the end as written.
explanation.definitionFit: A common yellow-flowered weed of lawns is a familiar plant.

indicators.note: off means the letter for piano is taken away from the word for jump

parts.note: to pounce is to jump on something
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: A cat might leap down from the piano.
explanation.definitionFit: The snow leopard is also called by this name, a big wild feline.

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
a road is a passage or way

explanation.surface: A seaman needs a voyage to foreign parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a foreign country, across the sea, is being out of one's homeland.

clue.text: As seen through a glass lightly?

definitions.text: As seen through a glass lightly?

parts.words: As seen through a glass lightly?
parts.note: plays on the Bible's 'through a glass, darkly': light passed through a prism shows a band of colours

explanation.walkthrough: The clue twists the Biblical phrase 'through a glass, darkly' (1 Corinthians 13).
explanation.definitionFit: White light passed through a glass prism splits into a rainbow band of colours.

explanation.surface: A sorcerer who can fly.
explanation.definitionFit: King Arthur's magician and a small falcon share this name.

clue.text: Advanced in a rush, but thought better of it

indicators.note: in means the word for advanced is placed inside the word for rush

parts.note: a reed is a rush, the waterside plant
advanced money means lent it

explanation.surface: Someone charged forward hastily, then changed their mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advanced' and 'rush' look like haste, but one is money lent and the other a marsh plant.
explanation.definitionFit: To soften or give way after first refusing is to reconsider and yield.

clue.text: Being biased is only right, perhaps

definitions.meaning: having just a right side and no left, with only a single flank

explanation.surface: Showing prejudice is simply the correct thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: A partial, unbalanced account favours one party, like something with a single flank.

parts.note: to stand something is to tolerate it
a concern is a business, a firm

explanation.surface: Put up with worry but hold your ground.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold one's position resolutely is to refuse to give way.

clue.text: Sir John's employees on the river

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, so the definition reads Sir John is

indicators.note: employees on the river means the workers' word is set against the river's name, coming after it

parts.note: the Fal is a river in Cornwall
staff are employees

explanation.surface: A knight's workers are out on the water.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir John is Shakespeare's fat knight in Henry IV. The Fal is a river in Cornwall; 'on' places STAFF after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's comic knight, Sir John, carouses with Prince Hal in Henry IV.

indicators.note: complicated means the letters of clear and and are tangled into a different order

explanation.surface: A list of dates that is both plain and intricate.
explanation.definitionFit: A chart setting out the days and months of the year lists dates.

parts.note: piecework usually means paid labour by the item, here it is art built from pieces stuck together

explanation.definitionFit: A picture made by gluing scraps of paper and fabric onto a backing is art assembled from pieces.

clue.text: Does it fly on a wing and a prayer?

definitions.text: Does it fly on a wing and a prayer?

parts.words: Does it fly on a wing and a prayer?
parts.note: the insect called the praying one has wings and folds its forelegs as if in prayer

explanation.definitionFit: The praying insect holds its forelegs together as if at prayer, and it has wings.

definitions.meaning: a prison sentence, a spell inside

explanation.surface: A moment ripe for growth.
explanation.definitionFit: A term in jail and a lengthening both go by this word.

indicators.note: loosely means the letters of sail and hung are slackly rearranged

explanation.surface: A banner and a sail droop slackly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flag' looks like a banner beside the sail, but it is the verb meaning to weaken.
explanation.definitionFit: To flag is to weaken or droop, and to pine away is to lose vigour.

indicators.note: devious means winding, so the letters of ruses are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: Junkies resort to sly tricks.
explanation.definitionFit: People who take drugs habitually are commonly called this.

parts.note: leader suggests a leading article, but here it is the person in charge of the paper

explanation.definitionFit: The person running a paper and deciding its content heads the newsroom.

definitions.meaning: a drink raised to someone's health

explanation.surface: Wholemeal loaf is good for you.
explanation.definitionFit: Grilled sliced bread and a raised-glass salute share this word.

explanation.surface: Noticing a blemish.
explanation.definitionFit: To glimpse something and a small skin blemish share this word.

clue.text: Put oil on a fish, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the clue words are taken by their sound when spoken

parts.note: an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: Someone is oiling a fish before cooking it.
explanation.walkthrough: ANELE is an archaic word meaning to anoint, mostly found in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: To anoint, especially as a sacrament, is an old word for applying oil.

clue.text: He presumably hopes not to miss the post

definitions.text: He presumably hopes not to miss the post

parts.words: He presumably hopes not to miss the post
parts.note: suggests someone racing the mail collection, but the post is a job vacancy

explanation.definitionFit: A candidate for a job wants to secure the position applied for.

clue.text: Marriage for security cannot be struck just anywhere

definitions.meaning: a match, or marriage, made for protection
a type of match that lights only on its own box

explanation.surface: A secure marriage cannot be broken off just anywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A light ignites only on the special strip of its box, unlike strike-anywhere lights.
